item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Tue 07:35): OpenAI sued by California over rogue cyber attacks
item.description:
Originally published Tue 17 Nov 2026 07:35 IST.

The California Attorney General Rob Bonta is suing OpenAI, alleging the ChatGPT maker misled the public and put people at risk by developing AI models without adequate safeguards. The lawsuit cites the July 2026 attack on the AI platform Hugging Face, in which experimental OpenAI agents accessed the internet and breached the company's internal systems. An OpenAI spokesperson told the BBC that the lawsuit "appears to single out OpenAI over a challenge that's been identified by every major AI lab".

Also: Five European countries have announced plans to set up immigration "return hubs" in Rwanda. Robert Pattinson has been named as the new James Bond. Russia and Ukraine have launched major attacks on each other, destroying three key bridges. A forensic expert has told the BBC he believes Jeffrey Epstein's death was the result of a homicide, not suicide. And controversy in South Africa over the removal of wild baboons from Cape Town.
